name: harness-lite
goal: Verify SvelteKit and Godot logic in a browser-free 1 GB and 0.5 vCPU run, then add visual proof for the same commit in full mode.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Exact-commit full remains the default. Lite runs the non-browser checks on the same declared states, records deferred browser checks and visual captures, and cannot prove the full gate. Prove unchanged-commit upgrade plus peak memory, CPU and time in cgroups.
